name: SwipeActions
summary: Actions hidden at either side of one list row, revealed by a horizontal swipe, with a menu button that holds the same actions for anyone who cannot or does not swipe. On ios the row slides to show square tone filled actions and a long swipe runs the first one; on android the same reveal with square ends; on web the menu button shows on hover and focus, and a mouse drags only when the app allows it.
useWhen: Two or three quick actions on rows of a long list people triage: mail, messages, tasks, saved items
An action people repeat on many rows (archive, delete, mark read) that would crowd every row as a visible button
avoidWhen: The only way to reach an action: every swipe action must also be somewhere people can see
Rows of a selection list or a table
More than three actions on a side
A row that already has its own horizontal gesture, such as a carousel or a slider

start.description: Actions at the inline start (the left in English, the right in Arabic), revealed by a swipe toward the inline end. Each is { label, icon, tone, onSelect, undoable }. At most three; more are dropped. The first sits at the outer edge.

end.description: Actions at the inline end (the right in English, the left in Arabic), revealed by a swipe toward the inline start. The same shape and limit as start.

start[].tone.description: The fill of the action: gray, the tint, orange or red. The label meets 4.5:1 on each. Sets data-tone on the action, and on its group from the edge action.

start[].undoable.description: The app can undo the action (an Undo in a toast). A first end action that is danger runs by a full swipe only when this is true.

fullSwipe.description: The side whose first action a long swipe runs on release. Default: end when the first end action is not danger or is undoable, else none. A danger action with no undo never runs from a full swipe unless the app asks.

menuLabel.description: The accessible name of the menu button and of each action group, naming the row: Actions for Sara Alqahtani, خيارات رسالة سارة القحطاني.

pointer.description: Lets a mouse drag the row too. Touch and pen always swipe. Off by default on the web, where the menu button is the mouse path.

children.description: The content that moves, in the content part. Leave it out when passing SwipeActions to ListItem as swipe: the row is the content and the root becomes the row's swipe part.

a11y.role: No role on the root. Each action group is a group named by menuLabel and is inert while closed, so a reader and Tab meet only the menu button. The menu button opens a menu of every action (role menu, menuitem each).
a11y.focus: The menu button is a Tab stop after the row's content. On touch it is visually hidden until focus is in the row, then drawn; with a mouse that hovers it is always drawn. While the row is open its actions are Tab stops too. Escape closes an open row; focus inside a closing group moves to the menu button first.

keys.Tab: Moves to the menu button after the row's content, and to the open actions while the row is open
keys.Shift+F10: Opens the menu of every action from anywhere in the row (the path that needs no drag, WCAG 2.5.7)
keys.Enter: On the menu button, opens the menu; on a menu item or an open action, runs it
keys.Escape: Closes the open menu, and then an open row
keys.Pointer: A touch or pen press that moves 10px more across than down swipes: the row follows the finger; let go past half the actions it opens, past the full swipe threshold it runs the first action of that side, else it springs closed. A flick opens or closes by its direction. A tap on the open row's content or outside it closes it. The menu button does every action with one tap and no drag (WCAG 2.5.7).

a11y.announce: Actions for Sara Alqahtani, menu button. The menu reads each action by its label. Action groups are inert while closed, so nothing is read twice.
notes: Every swipe action is in the menu; the full swipe is never the only way (WCAG 2.5.7). A danger full swipe with no undo is off by default.
Revealed actions are at least 44 CSS px wide and fill the row's height; the menu button is a 32px IconButton (WCAG 2.5.8).
Labels sit on the tone fill at 4.5:1: danger and warning on their solid with the on solid text, accent on the primary fill with the primary text, neutral on surface 5 with the default text.

The row sets touch-action pan-y: a vertical pan scrolls the page, a horizontal one swipes. The swipe takes pointer capture once it starts, and the click that ends it is swallowed so a row link does not follow.
One row is open at a time: opening or dragging another closes the open one.
Right to left: end actions sit at the left and are revealed by a swipe toward the right; start actions sit at the right. The full swipe follows the same side.
Under forced colors the groups are Canvas and each action has a ButtonText outline.
Reduced motion: the settle after a release is a jump (duration tokens are 0ms); the row still follows the finger while it is dragged.
React Native (phase R5): one accessibilityActions entry per swipe action, named by its label, is the path that needs no drag.

en.label: One short verb: Delete, Archive, Mute, Pin, Mark unread. Sentence case.
en.menuLabel: Actions for, then the row's title: Actions for Sara Alqahtani.

ar.label: اسم قصير بدون تشكيل: حذف، أرشفة، كتم، تثبيت، تعليم كغير مقروء.
ar.menuLabel: خيارات، ثم عنوان الصف: خيارات رسالة سارة القحطاني.

react.behavior: hand built: pointer events with capture, swipe logic from @the-system/shared swipe.ts, Radix DropdownMenu for the menu path
react.note: Motion: the row follows the pointer with no transition, then settles on the snappy spring (duration.spring-snappy) by a CSS transition; the full swipe arms with a quick fade of the other actions. Named under drag-drop, the catalog's drag and settle pattern; a swipe row pattern of its own is a request to the motion owner. Reduced motion: the settle is a jump.

angular.note: New wave 2: the same DOM, swipe.ts for the logic, CDK Menu for the menu path.

native.note: Phase R5 draws the row with react-native-gesture-handler Swipeable and Reanimated (both on the allow list), with accessibilityActions for every swipe action as the path that needs no drag.

styles.web: The menu button at the inline end of the row shows on hover and focus; touch swipes as on a phone; square tone filled actions.
styles.ios: The row slides to reveal square tone filled actions with the icon above the label, the first at the edge; a long swipe stretches the edge action over the row and runs it.
styles.android: The same reveal with square action ends (owner decision 7, proposed): the row slides, the actions sit under the edge.
styles.studio: The same on the Studio tokens; no recipe.
styles.desk: The same on the Desk tokens; no recipe.
styles.neutral: The same on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.
styles.liquid: The same on the Liquid tokens; no recipe yet (look order M9.13).

mistakes.wrong: A row whose delete is only behind a swipe
mistakes.right: Every swipe action is also in the menu, which SwipeActions draws for you

mistakes.wrong: fullSwipe end on a danger action with no undo
mistakes.right: fullSwipe none, or undoable true with an Undo in a toast after the delete

mistakes.wrong: Placing the actions with left and right
mistakes.right: start and end: the component mirrors them in Arabic

mistakes.wrong: A menuLabel of Actions on every row
mistakes.right: Actions for Sara Alqahtani, so each menu button has its own name
<ListItem swipe={<SwipeActions end={...} menuLabel=... />} />, so the row stays a list item
